name: edesktop
description: Windows 10/11 桌面整理与效率工具
author: six486486

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,APP -c yellow,cyan "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.package:win: npm run generate:icon && npm run prepare:electron-runtime && npm run build && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.make:win: npm run generate:icon && npm run prepare:electron-runtime && npm run build && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.capture: npm run build && cross-env EDESKTOP_CAPTURE_PATH=.artifacts/control-center.png EDESKTOP_CAPTURE_SURFACE=control electron .
scripts.capture:desktop: npm run build && cross-env EDESKTOP_CAPTURE_PATH=.artifacts/desktop-layer.png EDESKTOP_CAPTURE_SURFACE=desktop electron .
scripts.test:desktop-host: npm run build && cross-env EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST=1 EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST_DEMO=1 EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST_REGRESSION=1 electron .
scripts.test:widget-zorder: npm run build && cross-env EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST=1 EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST_DEMO=1 EDESKTOP_WIDGET_WINDOW_TEST=1 electron .
scripts.test:organizer-promotion: npm run build && cross-env EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST=1 EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST_DEMO=1 EDESKTOP_ORGANIZER_PROMOTION_TEST=1 electron .
scripts.test:drag-out: npm run build && cross-env EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST=1 EDESKTOP_HOST_TEST_DEMO=1 EDESKTOP_DRAG_TEST=1 electron .
